verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt at developer.bill.com (HTTP 200), and the doc pages are served as .md files. BILL also has a dedicated 'AI agent resources' page describing a documentation MCP server for Cursor, Windsurf and Claude Desktop, so agents have several documented ways into the docs. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of how well agents use these resources, and the full content and coverage of llms.txt (the probe output is truncated).
